children.name: Verify API authentication returns valid session data
TC-API-1 [POST /ownSecurity/signIn] Verify successful authentication via ownSecurityClient.signIn
TC-API-2 [POST /ownSecurity/signIn] Verify authentication failure with invalid credentials
TC-API-3 [GET /ownSecurity/updateAccessToken] Verify access token refresh endpoint returns 200 with new tokens
TC-API-4 [GET /ownSecurity/password-status] Verify getPasswordStatus returns hasPassword status
TC-API-5 [GET /ownSecurity/restorePassword] Verify restorePassword endpoint handles recovery request
TC-API-7 [POST /ownSecurity/updatePassword] Verify updatePassword returns error for inactive or invalid token
TC-API-6 [PUT /ownSecurity/changePassword] Verify changePassword validates mismatched passwords for authenticated user
TC-API-8 [POST /ownSecurity/set-password] Verify set-password rejects request when user already has a password
TC-API-9 [POST /ownSecurity/unblockAccount] Verify unblockAccount endpoint handles request with token
Own Security API - Parameterized Email Language & Verification Flow
TC-API-EMAIL-EN [POST /ownSecurity/signUp, GET /ownSecurity/verifyEmail] Verify registration email language, content and verification for lang=en
TC-API-EMAIL-UK [POST /ownSecurity/signUp, GET /ownSecurity/verifyEmail] Verify registration email language, content and verification for lang=uk
Own Security API - Role-Based Endpoints (Admin, Employee, Moderator)
TC-API-ROLE-1 [GET /ownSecurity/authorities/categories] Verify admin authorities categories endpoint via admin role
TC-API-ROLE-2 [GET /ownSecurity/authorities/by-category] Verify admin authorities by category endpoint via admin role
TC-API-ROLE-3 [POST /ownSecurity/register] Verify register endpoint via admin role
TC-API-ROLE-4 [POST /ownSecurity/sign-up-employee] Verify signUpEmployee endpoint via employee role
TC-API-ROLE-5 [ROLE FACTORY] Verify authorizedClient throws error for unsupported role
